versions.subject: GUP LOLBIN Rules + Update AccCheckConsole Rule
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\AccCheckConsole.exe'
    OriginalFileName: 'AccCheckConsole.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -window '
        - '.dll'
condition: all of selection*
